transcript: Speaker A (Auto Driver): Hey! Why are you coming on the wrong side? You could have come under my tire! Speaker B (Biker): Mind your own business, old man! Speaker A: Shameless! Is this how you talk to someone twice your age? Keep riding like this and you won't make it past 30! Speaker C (Passenger): तो मुलगा तुमच्याशी किती उद्धटपणे बोलत होता. पण काका, तुम्ही इतकं छान English बोललात! इतकी चांगली English कशी शिकलात? [That boy was talking so rudely to you. But uncle, you spoke such great English! How did you learn such good English?] Speaker A: मी मराठीतून English शिकलोय असं सांगितलं, तर कदाचित तुमचा विश्वास बसणार नाही. [If I tell you I learned English from Marathi, you might not believe it.] Speaker C: थांबा, तुम्ही MySivi वापरलंय का? [Wait, have you used MySivi?] Speaker A: MySivi मध्ये AI teacher सोबत रोज १०-१५ मिनिटं English बोलायचा सराव करायचो. चूक झाली की तो लगेच दुरुस्त करायचा. मी शिकलो, तर कोणीही शिकू शकतं. [In MySivi, I used to practice speaking English with an AI teacher for 10-15 minutes daily. If I made a mistake, it would correct it immediately. If I learned, anyone can.] Speaker C: Same pinch काका! मी पण MySivi वरच शिकतीये. [Same pinch uncle! I am also learning on MySivi.] Speaker A: मग तुम्हालाही English बोलायला शिकायचं असेल, तर आजच MySivi app download करा, १ रुपया ट्रायल सुरू करा आणि practice ला सुरुवात करा. [So if you also want to learn to speak English, download the MySivi app today, start the 1 rupee trial, and start practicing.]
